title: version_is_newer special case (0,127) duplicates lollipop_cmp logic
description: File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs Line 77-78. The special case (new_ver, old_ver) == (0, 127) handles the linear-to-circular transition but lollipop_cmp already handles this via wrap_distance calculation. For (0, 127): a=0 linear, b=127 linear, abs_diff=127 > 16, returns None. So the special case is necessary. However, this duplicates RFC 6550 Appendix A logic - the special case encodes one specific valid wraparound while lollipop_cmp uses SEQUENCE_WINDOW for others. Document why this special case exists alongside the general algorithm.
close_reason: The bead's premise is incorrect. The special case (0, 127) in version_is_newer is NOT duplicate logic - it is an intentional policy override. lollipop_cmp(0, 127) returns None (incomparable) because both values are in the same region (0-127) with a gap of 127 exceeding SEQUENCE_WINDOW (16). The wrap_distance logic only applies to cross-region comparisons. The explicit test at line 1117 confirms: assert_eq!(lollipop_cmp(0, 127), None) followed by assert!(version_is_newer(0, 127)). This is a DODAG-specific policy decision to treat the 127->0 restart as a valid version bump, not a duplication. No changes needed.
